title: Phase-02 Egress-Sink Inventory
description: Path-sensitive inventory of every code path that can emit a resource's bytes to a caller. Consumed by scripts/validate-egress.py. The unit of analysis is the BRANCH (guarded_paths[]), not the handler — this is what makes a conditional unauthenticated-bypass branch expressible. Every deterministic candidate from lib/egress-detection.md MUST appear here as a sink OR in dismissed[] with a reason (fail-closed coverage).

serves_resource.description: Canonical data_model entity id this sink emits. The join key for reconciliation — must reference a profile.data_model entity (not free text).

reachable_via.description: Surface ids (or external path templates) that reach this sink.

intended_gate.description: The strongest gate the served resource declares (RBAC / tenant-ownership / 2FA-share / OIDC). Optional — reconciliation also derives the floor from credentials + sibling branches + resolve-layer surfaces.

guarded_paths.description: EVERY branch in the handler that can emit bytes, with the authz enforced ON THAT BRANCH. A handler with N emitting branches must list N entries; under-reporting ⇒ set coverage:incomplete.

condition.description: The branch's guard condition (e.g. 'an active publishLink exists').

enforced_gate.description: The authorization actually enforced on this branch, or 'none'. Free text; ranked by keyword in validate-egress.py (gate_rank).

coverage.description: complete = every emitting branch enumerated. incomplete = fail-closed deficit (handler has more emitting branches than recorded). caveat = mechanically un-gateable (e.g. CDN-edge), surfaced as a report caveat.

dismissed.description: Deterministic candidates the agent inspected and ruled out (not a sensitive-data sink). Required so the coverage gate can tell 'accounted-for' from 'silently omitted'.

candidate.description: file or file:line of the candidate.
